# Basics

Fundamental type inference and type checking for primitive and special types.

## Coverage

- **Primitives**: `number`, `string`, `boolean`, `bigint`, `symbol`
- **Special types**: `null`, `undefined`, `void`, `never`, `any`, `unknown`
- **Type inference**: Literal widening, contextual typing
- **Type annotations**: Explicit type declarations

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `primitives.md` | Primitive type assignability |
| `special.md` | null, undefined, void |
| `any.md` | The `any` type (erased top type) |
| `widening.md` | Numeric type widening (int8 → int16, etc.) |
